toolsPage.description: Start with the question you want to answer. Select a tool to see what it needs and what its result means.

score.limit: These are simulated product comparisons. They do not report live rankings inside AI shopping apps.

validator.limit: A valid published profile does not confirm that a buyer can complete checkout. Use the playground to test store tools.

playground.input: A store exposing agent shopping tools
playground.limit: The agent calls store tools. Use a staging store for checkout tests.

scanner.limit: Inspects a small sample of pages and scripts. It does not run JavaScript, submit forms or verify that browser tools work.

compare.limit: Each model makes a simulated choice using the compared listings. This is not a live shopping placement report.
